name: PEARL + reward + InfoNCE encoder
tagline: PEARL product-of-Gaussians encoder with two extra encoder losses: reward-prediction supervision and split-context InfoNCE for task discrimination.
diff_from_baseline: Keeps PEARL's product-of-Gaussians + SAC core, but adds (i) a reward decoder loss for direct task-id supervision and (ii) a contrastive InfoNCE loss between two halves of each task's context — neither used by PEARL/FOCAL/VariBAD baselines.

name: Self-attention encoder + Gaussian SAC
tagline: Replaces PEARL's product-of-Gaussians aggregator with a self-attention encoder that mean-and-max pools the attended transitions into (μ, logσ²).
diff_from_baseline: Drops PEARL's per-transition product-of-Gaussians for a self-attention encoder followed by mean+max pooling, then a single Gaussian posterior; otherwise inherits PEARL's SAC + KL training pipeline.

name: PEARL with attention-weighted PoG
tagline: Per-transition encoder outputs (μ, σ², attention logit); attention softmax over the sequence weights both the mean and variance instead of the product-of-Gaussians.
formula:
$$\mathrm{MLP}(o_t,a_t,r_t) \to (\mu_t, s_t = \mathrm{softplus}(\cdot), \ell_t)$$
$$w_t = \mathrm{softmax}_t(\ell_t),\quad \mu = \sum_t w_t\mu_t,\ \sigma^2 = \sum_t w_t s_t,\quad z \sim \mathcal N(\mu, \sigma^2)$$
diff_from_baseline: Replaces PEARL's product-of-Gaussians aggregator with a learned per-transition attention head (softmax over sequence) that linearly combines (μ_t, σ²_t); keeps SAC + KL otherwise unchanged.

name: PEARL + reward-aware prototype fusion
tagline: Probabilistic encoder plus a deterministic prototype encoder; the policy sees a confidence-blended z = exp(-σ²)·z_stoch + (1-exp(-σ²))·z_proto.
diff_from_baseline: Beyond PEARL, adds a parallel deterministic prototype encoder, blends it with the stochastic z by an uncertainty-driven gate exp(-σ²), and (in sparse settings) up-weights high-reward transitions in the prototype average; also includes a reward decoder.

name: Mean-pool Gaussian + reward consistency
tagline: Per-transition (μ, logσ²) encoder mean-pooled across context; encoder trained jointly with a reward-prediction decoder and standard SAC.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces PEARL's product-of-Gaussians with a simple mean of per-transition (μ, logσ²); adds a reward-consistency MSE decoder; otherwise SAC training is identical to PEARL.
